title.narrative: Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation (CAREC) Corridor 2 Road Investment Program - Tranche 1

description.narrative: Under the CAREC Corridor 2 Road Investment Program, the Project will comprise civil works for rehabilitating about 50 km of the Uzbekistan Section of CAREC Corridor 2 Road (between Km 440 and 490 of A380 highway), support to to the expansion and implementation of the road asset management system, and support capacity building for the Road Fund and the local communities living along the Investment Program road.

title.narrative: Loan 2635: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 25 Nov 2024
Progress Toward Outcome: The road construction work has been completed. Full attainment of the project impact will depend on the completion of the entire investment program.

Status of Implementation Progress: Road pavement construction is complete. Taking over certificate was issued by the Engineer on 31 October 2013. Defects notification period is ongoing.
The Road Fund allotted a 240 km section (Kungrad-Daut-ata) of the A380 highway for pilot testing the PPP framework using performance based maintenance contract based on FIDIC guidelines. RAMS consultant prepared the framework and the contractual structure.
The independent quality control system for road works has been established.
